description: Save a new version of one of your own skills. Every save is a new immutable version; the previous one is kept. Takes the slug and the same fields as skills_create. A published skill cannot be edited: fork it first with skills_fork.

situation.description: The problem, in your words. Optional.

source.description: The skill file itself, markdown with frontmatter.

title.description: Query-shaped, like a published skill's title.

tools.description: The tools it uses, by name.

name: skills_update
